claim: Demo changes are temporary and never change real cards
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real card, change and reset the demo, reload, then assert the real card is unchanged

claim: Each game card can hold motion triggers, an ordered settings plan, and symptom check-ins
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert the completed sample exposes its game, triggers, ordered settings, tried state, and finished check-in

claim: No account, ads, analytics, or third-party runtime requests are used
where: landing facts and footer, card form, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; intercept the complete sample session flow and assert every request is same-origin and no real database opens

claim: Clean share text and files exclude check-ins, dates, durations, symptom scores, and private notes
sandbox: fresh /demo context; inspect the generated share text and downloaded clean-card file from the completed sample session

claim: A play session starts a 15-minute check-in timer that can be paused or stopped
sandbox: fresh /demo context; start a session, assert the observable timer begins at 15 minutes, pause it, then stop and save it

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh /demo context; wait for service worker control, switch the context offline, reload, and assert the sample card remains usable

claim: Card planning and check-ins are free and require no account
sandbox: fresh /demo context; start a sample session without account, payment, checkout, or subscription controls

claim: Real game cards stay saved in this browser across reloads
where: landing facts, card form, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; leave demo, create a real card, reload its direct URL, and assert it remains available

claim: A full backup file includes and restores saved cards, sessions, check-ins, and private notes
where: home card tools, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; leave demo, create a card and private check-in, inspect a downloaded backup, clear storage, import it, and assert the session returns
